task.description: Implement REQ-181: the webhook_subscriptions table (per-tenant schema, tenant_id retained) and Letflow.Webhooks context module (create/2, list/1, update/3, delete/2, get/2), per the validated design in lib/letflow/design/req181-webhooks-core.md. No route/controller file.
acceptance_criteria: the webhook_subscriptions table lives inside each tenant's Postgres schema with a tenant_id column retained, matching decision 0003 Decision B's pattern -- verified by inspecting the migration

create/2 with no secret supplied generates one, stores only a hashed form in the database, and returns the plaintext exactly once as hmac_secret_once in its return value; a subsequent list/1 or get of the same subscription never includes the plaintext secret or an hmac_secret_once key at all -- two explicit tests

update/2 accepts %{status: "PAUSED"} and, separately, %{is_active: false}, and both result in a subscription that subsequently reads back as status "PAUSED" -- reconciling WebhookSubscription's dual status/is_active representation to one stored state
list/1 is tenant-scoped, demonstrated by a subscription created under tenant A being absent from a list/1 call scoped to tenant B
delete/2 removes the subscription such that a subsequent list/1 no longer includes it, and a second delete/2 of the same id returns a not-found error rather than a duplicate success
no route or controller file is added or modified, confirmed by git diff --stat scoped to this requirement's commits
mix test and mix compile --warnings-as-errors both pass with real output quoted
